shortDescription: This module configures and manages replication policies on IBM Spectrum Virtualize family storage systems

options.name: clustername
options.description: The hostname or management IP of the Spectrum Virtualize storage system.

options.name: domain
options.description: Domain for the Spectrum Virtualize storage system. Valid when hostname is used for the parameter I(clustername).

options.name: location1iogrp
options.description: Specifies the ID of the I/O group of the system in location 1 of the topology.

options.name: location1system
options.description: Specifies the name or ID of the system in location 1 of the topology.

options.name: location2iogrp
options.description: Specifies the ID of the I/O group of the system in location 2 of the topology.

options.name: location2system
options.description: Specifies the name or ID of the system in location 2 of the topology.

options.name: name
options.description: Specifies the name of the replication policy.

options.name: password
options.description: REST API password for the Spectrum Virtualize storage system. The parameters I(username) and I(password) are required if not using I(token) to authenticate a user.

options.name: rpoalert
options.description: Specifies the RPO alert threshold in seconds. The minimum value is 60 (1 minute) and the maximum value is 86400 (1 day). The value must be a multiple of 60 seconds.

options.name: state
options.description: Creates, updates (C(present)), or deletes (C(absent)) a replication policy.

options.name: token
options.description: The authentication token to verify a user on the Spectrum Virtualize storage system. To generate a token, use the M(ibm.spectrum_virtualize.ibm_svc_auth) module.

options.name: username
options.description: REST API username for the Spectrum Virtualize storage system. The parameters I(username) and I(password) are required if not using I(token) to authenticate a user.
